findings.title: run_agent (and other non-custom paths) echo raw host exception text on the wire
findings.evidence: adversarial script adv_runagent_leak.py: host.execute raising RuntimeError('SECRET-HOST-FAILURE-hunter2 /srv/app/db.py:42') yields ToolError "Error calling tool 'run_agent': SECRET-HOST-FAILURE-hunter2 /srv/app/db.py:42"; no MCP_INTERNAL_ERROR mapping. Only custom host tools are wrapped (mcp_server_engine._run_custom_host_tool_bounded).
findings.contradicts: MCP_SERVER_X_RC_CONTRACT_MATRIX.md (MCP_INTERNAL_ERROR: raw exception text is never echoed); corrections record G-RB-04 / G-ERR-01 CLOSED_IN_CODE
findings.recommended_disposition: REJECT CLOSED_IN_CODE for G-RB-04; product change: map non-ToolError exceptions of run_agent, list_agents and catalog discovery to MCP_INTERNAL_ERROR with the exception class only; add a test (no existing test covers it).

findings.title: After the call bound fires, a host task that ends cancelled or failed does not produce MCP_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED
findings.evidence: adv_deadline_cancelled.py (max_call_seconds=0.3, drain patched to 0.25s): host ending by raising CancelledError after the governed cancel -> client receives 'McpError Connection closed' (CancelledError escapes _await_host_or_deadline via host_coro.result() into the run_host_execution CancelledError handler and out of the tool); host raising RuntimeError -> raw text echoed (see AF-01) instead of the declared deadline outcome. Code: mcp_host_execution_transport_cancel._await_host_or_deadline.
findings.scope_note: Observed with a host double and the in-memory transport; production HostTaskExecutionPort normally returns a terminal TaskResult CANCELLED rather than raising, so production reachability is PLAUSIBLE, not demonstrated.
findings.recommended_disposition: Product change: treat host task outcome 'cancelled' or exception after the bound as outcome=cancelled / MCP_INTERNAL_ERROR without leaking; add a test for a host whose Task ends cancelled and for a host that raises after the governed cancel.

findings.title: Custom host tools are not covered by the fail-closed principal gate
findings.evidence: adv_identity.py H4: a custom host tool composed on a host without auth is callable over real streamable HTTP in the default HARNESS_BOUND mode (result {"tenant_data":"SECRET-1"}). _bind_custom_host_tool_for_fastmcp / _run_custom_host_tool_bounded call no require_mcp_caller_principal; only run_research_pipeline self-gates through execute_mcp_agent_task_with_resolved_identity.
findings.contradicts: corrections record G-ID-06 'gated for every tool'; ADR decision 1 (one identity authority, fail-closed by default)
findings.recommended_disposition: Product change (gate custom tools by default with an explicit per-binding opt-out) OR amend the ADR/record to state that custom tools are host-owned and ungated, with a migration note; until then G-ID-06 is PARTIAL.

findings.title: Cross-loop payload bound wiring and default-mode catalog discovery gates are not pinned by any test (5 auditor mutants survive)
findings.evidence: auditor mutants A3 and A3b (removal of bound_cross_loop_catalog_payload at the bridge call sites) survive the result-bound suite AND the two cross-loop suites; A12 and A13 (removal of require_mcp_caller_principal from list_catalog_tools / describe_catalog_tool) survive identity, bounds, discovery, trust-A and L2 security suites; A11 (LOCAL_DEV downgrade guard for an explicit harness_auth argument) survives. Implementer mutation set covered 8 invariants only.
findings.recommended_disposition: No product change required (code reviewed correct); add tests that kill A3, A3b, A12, A13 (and A11) before certification; G-RB-02 and the discovery part of G-ID-06 need this evidence.

findings.title: Real factory composition order is never exercised; R-P7-02 opt-in vehicle replaced by the lab app
findings.evidence: old tests (6a6279a49) re-run at HEAD with --runxfail: 5 failed / 10 passed; causes are LLMProviderNotConfiguredError and StrictAgentContractAuthorityError, i.e. not MCP-owned (implementer root cause CONFIRMED). But no test now builds the real local-workspace/product factory with include_mcp=True; G-ID-02/G-ID-09 are proven on synthetic FastAPI apps and the eight build_*_mcp_server facade builders only. All eight factories call couple_harness_host_fastapi_with_mcp with the facade default identity mode.
findings.recommended_disposition: ACCEPT the vehicle replacement as ACCEPTED_SCOPED with the explicit statement that real-product factory composition is unverified; require a tracked owner/ticket for restoring a strict product vehicle (together with the TRANSFERRED xfail).

findings.title: The call bound is not the wall-time bound: bound + 30 s drain
findings.evidence: adv_bounds_deadline.py deadline: max_call_seconds=1.0, non-cooperative host, default drain -> client error after 31.2 s (MCP_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED outcome=outcome_unknown); _HOST_DRAIN_AFTER_TRANSPORT_CANCEL_S=30.0. The deadline tests shrink the drain to 0.25 s so the default is never exercised.
findings.recommended_disposition: Document the effective bound (max_call_seconds + drain) in the contract matrix/ADR; optionally expose the drain; add one test at the default constant or assert the documented value.

findings.title: ADR decision 5 / OD-MCP-RC-02 wording ('only a governed-cancel trigger') does not hold for LOCAL_DEV run_agent and catalog invoke
findings.evidence: mcp_nexus_server.execute_mcp_agent_task: with no cancel context the bound is asyncio.wait_for (direct cancel of the awaited host coroutine, no governed cancel, no supervision handoff); mcp_catalog_invocation_bridge: invoke_timeout_s = max_call_seconds applied through asyncio.wait_for around child_port.execute and the cross-loop wait. No canonical Execution deadline is created or overridden (no second deadline authority in the Execution sense).
findings.recommended_disposition: ACCEPT with an ADR/record amendment stating the two non-governed mechanisms and their limits (G-DL-02 already ACCEPTED_SCOPED).

findings.title: LOCAL_DEV loopback guard trusts request.client.host
findings.evidence: is_loopback_client accepts 127.0.0.0/8, ::1, 'localhost' and the literal 'testclient'. Real-network test (LAN IP 192.168.0.51, XFF/Forwarded spoof headers): refused as designed. A reverse proxy on the same host makes every remote client appear as loopback.
findings.recommended_disposition: Document that LOCAL_DEV_EXPLICIT must never be composed behind a same-host reverse proxy; consider dropping the 'testclient' literal outside tests.

findings.title: execute_mcp_agent_task stays a public, exported entry that accepts caller-asserted tenant/user
findings.evidence: exported by mcp_application_server.__all__ and mcp_developer_api.__all__; with caller_request_identity=None it runs the task with the given tenant/user and only labels it mcp_identity_assertion=unverified (label is not consumed by any enforcement).
findings.recommended_disposition: Document as low-level/unsafe or deprecate; ensure the developer guide points to execute_mcp_agent_task_with_resolved_identity.

findings.title: Pathological results (deep nesting, circular) escape as uncoded errors
findings.evidence: adv_bounds_deadline.py bounds: nested depth 5000 -> "Error calling tool 'deep': maximum recursion depth exceeded"; circular -> 'Circular reference detected'. isError=true, no secrets, but neither MCP_RESULT_BOUND_EXCEEDED nor MCP_INTERNAL_ERROR (bound check runs outside the try in _run_custom_host_tool_bounded). 3 MB string, 2M-int list and 300k small objects are all rejected as MCP_RESULT_BOUND_EXCEEDED quickly (0.00-0.22 s) and the event loop stays live.
findings.recommended_disposition: Map encoder exceptions to MCP_RESULT_BOUND_EXCEEDED/MCP_INTERNAL_ERROR (can be fixed together with AF-01).

findings.title: Qualification reference server defaults to LOCAL_DEV_EXPLICIT; the 'no second authority' gate is name-based
findings.evidence: tests/qualification/mcp_server_x/reference_app/build.py defaults identity_mode=LOCAL_DEV_EXPLICIT, so most P7 in-process qualification tests (12 test/fixture files) run under the explicit opt-in. Default-mode behaviour is pinned for run_agent, list_agents, research tool and facades only (see AF-04 for the catalog discovery gap). test_engine_has_no_second_identity_or_deadline_authority only inspects function names.
findings.recommended_disposition: Accept; the hidden-default-mode check for catalog discovery is AF-04. Consider a behavioural gate for second-authority.

findings.title: Factory-composed hosts cannot opt in to LOCAL_DEV_EXPLICIT and five hosts have no auth wiring
findings.evidence: All eight host factories build the MCP server with the facade default (HARNESS_BOUND) and expose no identity_mode setting; hosts that never wire Harness Auth now reject every identity-bearing MCP tool. This is the declared breaking change (wire contract v1.1) but no factory/setting migration path exists.
findings.recommended_disposition: ACCEPT as declared; add a factory-level migration note or setting in a later change.

findings.title: max_call_seconds is unreachable through the eight facades and ignored by the research pipeline tool
findings.evidence: facade builders call compose_application_mcp_server without max_call_seconds; run_research_pipeline calls execute_mcp_agent_task_with_resolved_identity without max_call_seconds/boundary/supervision.
findings.recommended_disposition: Document or thread the parameter; no safety impact.

findings.title: Protocol-level initialize and tools/list are unauthenticated on hosts that require an API key
findings.evidence: adv_probe3/adv_probe4: unauthenticated initialize returns 200 and tools/list returns ['list_agents','run_agent'] on a host with require_api_key=True; tool calls are refused. Pre-existing transport behaviour.
findings.recommended_disposition: Document (tool names and input schemas are disclosed to unauthenticated clients).

findings.title: Result-returned domain errors are not isError
findings.evidence: execution_cancelled, execution_admission_denied and describe unknown_tool are returned as normal results with 'error' and 'mcp_code' keys (isError=false), as declared in the contract matrix.

findings.title: Strict xfail test_scaffold_defaults_mcp_to_opt_in[product] and the G-DOC items
findings.evidence: --runxfail reproduction: StrictAgentContractAuthorityError in package emission (not MCP). G-DOC-01..12 (P8 documentation defects) were not audited.
findings.recommended_disposition: ACCEPT the TRANSFERRED classification conditional on a named owner/ticket; G-DOC not covered by this audit.
